ds.title: Design system
ds.description: Tokens, typography, shape and brand of the Re-Teck template. The reference for prototyping screens.
ds.phaseNote: Foundation (phase 1) and components (phase 3). Page patterns arrive in phase 5.
ds.contrastNote: Every text/background pair passes WCAG 2.2 AA (npm run check:contrast).

colorRule.lead: Color follows meaning, not taste. One color, one meaning, across the whole system.
rules: Brand color is not a state color: brand green and lime stay in the logo, login, empty states and the line under the navbar.
Primary button = petrol blue. Secondary = neutral (outline). Dangerous = red. Green only when confirming a success (Approve, Complete).
Color is never the only signal: every status has text and an icon.
Notice background = light tint (~10%) with text and border in the strong tone.
Yellow is never text on a light background: text uses darkened amber.
Category charts use their own palette; state colors only when the chart means good/attention/bad.
colorRule.alertBody: 12 items are below minimum stock. Restock before month-end closing.

palette.lead: OKLCH 50–950 scales generated from the logo (npm run tokens). ★ = exact logo value. Components use semantic tokens, never the palette directly.

charts.lead: Category series use their own palette, derived from the brand and neutrals — no state colors.

typography.lead: Inter Variable for the interface (14px base), JetBrains Mono for codes, IDs and serials, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese.
typography.numbersLead: Values and tables use tabular figures and slashed zero (num class).
typography.cjkLead: Noto Sans TC loads only when the language is 繁體中文.

shape.shadowsLead: In dark theme, shadows become a border and a lighter surface.

density.lead: Comfortable (default) or compact: changes the height of fields, buttons and table rows.

brand.lead: Full logo in the navbar (light variant in dark theme), globe only on narrow screens. Icons generated from the globe (npm run brand).
brand.gradient: Brand gradient (line under the navbar, login, empty state)

c.statusLead: Every status comes from the statusMap: tone (color by meaning) + icon + label. The flow order is used to sort tables.
c.buttonsLead: Teal primary (one main action per area), neutral secondary, red for danger and green only to confirm success. Heights follow density.
c.withIcons: With icon and icon-only (always with an accessible label)
c.focusHint: Hover to see the hover state and press Tab to see focus (2px teal outline).
c.badgesLead: Neutral counter for pending items; red only when the number is about errors. Tags are free labels, not statuses.
c.fieldsLead: Every field has a label, required indicator, help text, an error linked to the field (aria-describedby) and a counter when there's a limit. Leave a masked field to validate it.

integracao.descricaoPagina: The external systems that talk to the iERP (today MoonShot, which processes the Dell lots): access key, notifications and progress panel.
integracao.descricaoPainel: How the iERP talks to the system: the dashboard and token; and, if it processes lots from here, the key and notifications.

ajuda.sistema: Each system belongs to a customer: where its lots go (Dell → MoonShot) or where they come from (Project Management).
ajuda.avisos: When a lot of the customer is received or corrected, the iERP notifies the system, which fetches the lot with the key. If it is offline, the notification stays queued and is resent.
ajuda.painel: Every 30 seconds the iERP reads which phase each lot is in there ("Processing 2/4 · Parts reading").
ajuda.token: The same token configured in the system (in MoonShot: IERP_PAINEL_TOKEN), with at least {{min}} characters.
ajuda.tokenGuardado: A token is already stored. Leave blank to keep it; type a new one to replace it.
ajuda.chave: The key the system uses to enter the iERP (in MoonShot: IERP2_API_KEY). It is shown only once, when generated.
ajuda.painelOrigem: The {{sistema}} dashboard address (the same one the old iERP reads), ending in /api/integracao/painel. The iERP reads the lots every 30 seconds.
ajuda.sincronizacao: Lots come from {{sistema}}: the iERP creates and updates them on its own, and they are view only here.
ajuda.caPainel: Only if {{sistema}} uses HTTPS with a Re-Teck CA certificate: paste the CA PUBLIC certificate (ca-reteck.crt, PEM). The iERP trusts it only for connections to this system.
ajuda.rastreador: The GPS tracker for trips (ReTeckTracker — the same one the old iERP uses). iERP 2.0 reads the trips of its lots, records the arrival code and listens to the tracker live; the driver app opens at <address>/app/.
ajuda.chaveInterna: The tracker's INTERNAL_API_KEY (the same one the old iERP uses). Never the driver app key.
ajuda.chaveTransito: Turns on the Traffic button on the Trips map. Without it, the button does not appear.
ajuda.chaveTransitoGuardada: Traffic key saved. Leave blank to keep it; type a new one to replace it.
ajuda.estoque: iERP 2.0 reads this system's stock list live (the same /api/integracao/estoque port the old iERP uses; nothing changes there). Address = the system root, without a path.
ajuda.chaveARMAZEM: Generate a key for iERP 2.0 in Inventory-Management (System › Settings › integration keys). It is shown only once.
ajuda.chaveNOTEBOOKS: The INTEGRACAO_CHAVE from Notebook Control's .env — the same one the old iERP uses.
ajuda.chaveRTB_WMS: RTB WMS's INTEGRACAO_CHAVE — the same one the old iERP uses.

documentos.removerBody: The file leaves the lot; the record stays in the history. This cannot be undone.

editar.descricao: Scheduling details. The lot can only be edited while it is scheduled.
editar.clienteFixo: The lot's customer does not change. For another customer, schedule a new lot.
editar.anexosAjuda: Files are in the Documents tab.
editar.escopoAjuda: Required: write the scope or keep a "Scope of work" document in the Documents tab.
editar.calculoAjuda: When saving, the pre-calculation is redone with the new data.
editar.travadoBody: The lot has already arrived at Re-Teck: the scheduling details no longer change. Log what changed as an incident.

processamento.aguardando: The lot was handed to {{sistema}}. It stays in Received until the first action there.

situacoes.aguardando: No balance yet: the lot gross weight or the packaging weight is missing.
situacoes.parcial: Partial balance: the lot is still being processed, and the difference shrinks as parts are scanned and scrap is sorted.
situacoes.fechado: The balance closed: the difference is within the ±{{tolerancia}} tolerance.
situacoes.fora: The difference exceeds the ±{{tolerancia}} tolerance. Check the weighings with operations.

balanco.explicam: Partly explained by: {{semPeso}} part(s) scanned without weight and {{foraDaLista}} tag(s) not on the list.
balanco.commoditiesVazioBody: Shown once scanned parts and sorted scrap are classified.
balanco.containersAjuda: A bigbag holds material from several lots: the "This lot" column is this lot's share.
balanco.containersVazioBody: Shown once this lot's material goes into a bigbag.

devolucao.titulo: {{sistema}} asked for the receiving to be corrected
devolucao.oQueFazer: Correct the receiving ("Correct receiving" button): {{sistema}} resumes the lot on its own.

deFora.texto: This lot is created, received and closed in {{sistema}}: here it is view only. Changes there show up here on their own within 30 seconds.
deFora.documentosAjuda: The documents stay in {{sistema}} and open there (it may ask for its login).
deFora.documentosVazio: {{sistema}} has no documents for this lot yet.
deFora.foraDoArBody: Weighings and documents show up here when it is back. The rest of the lot stays the same.
deFora.pesagensVazioBody: Receiving weighings show up here as soon as they are entered there.
deFora.documentosSoLa: This lot's documents stay in {{sistema}} and only open there (with its login).

recebimento.paginaDescricao: Receive scheduled lots: seals, invoices, visual inspection and pallets.
recebimento.descricao: Seals, invoices, visual inspection and pallets. When saving, the lot moves to Inspection.
recebimento.corrigirDescricao: It can be corrected while the lot is in Inspection. Every change stays in the history.
recebimento.bloqueadoReceber: This lot is no longer scheduled.
recebimento.bloqueadoCorrigir: The lot has left Inspection: the receiving no longer changes.
recebimento.loteEscolhido: The customer comes from the chosen lot.
recebimento.inspecaoAjuda: The condition the cargo arrived in. Damaged or Other become a Receiving incident on the lot.
recebimento.descricaoAjuda: Write in any language: the system translates it into the other two when saving. Do not include personal data.
recebimento.lacresAjuda: Optional. Each seal needs its number and at least one photo.
recebimento.notasAjuda: Optional. Each invoice needs its number and at least one photo.
recebimento.palletsAjuda: At least one pallet: gross weight and photo required; tare (empty pallet weight) optional.
recebimento.fotosGeraisAjuda: Optional. Receiving photos that are not of a pallet or a seal.

historicoModulo.ordens: Everything that happened in orders: scheduling, lot edits, documents and pickup/transit incidents.
historicoModulo.operacao: Everything that happened in operations: lots created, receiving and corrections, stage changes and receiving incidents.

cadastros.traduzAoSalvar: When saving, the system translates it into the other two languages.
cadastros.ajudaTraducao: Write in any language: the system translates it into the other two when saving.

materiais.descricao: Material that can go inside bins and pallets.
materiais.confirm: Inactive materials cannot be chosen for bins and pallets. Those already using it stay as they are.
materiais.inativoBody: Cannot be chosen for new bins and pallets.

areas.vazioBody: Register the warehouse areas where bins and pallets are kept.
areas.descricao: Warehouse area where bins and pallets are kept.
areas.confirm: Inactive areas cannot be chosen for bins and pallets. Those already in it stay.
areas.inativoBody: Cannot be chosen for new bins and pallets.

recipientes.vazioBody: Register the container with its material, tare, area and position.
recipientes.descricao_caixote: Warehouse bin: material, tare, area and position.
recipientes.descricao_pallet: Warehouse pallet: material, tare, area and position.
recipientes.confirm: Inactive containers are not available for use. The history stays.
recipientes.inativoBody: This container is not in use.
recipientes.codigoAjuda_caixote: The code (CXT-year + number) is generated when saving.
recipientes.codigoAjuda_pallet: The code (PLT-year + number) is generated when saving.
recipientes.semAreas: No active area: register one in the Warehouse areas tab.

rastreadores.integracaoBody: Truck trackers will come from the GPS system's API. Once it is connected, the devices show up here.
rastreadores.vazioBody: The list is filled by the integration with the GPS system.

paginas.materiais: Materials that go inside bins and pallets, in the 3 languages.
paginas.pallets: Warehouse pallets: material, tare, area and position.
paginas.caixotes: Warehouse bins: material, tare, area and position.
paginas.areas: Warehouse areas where bins and pallets are kept.
paginas.rastreadores: Truck GPS trackers (they come from the GPS system).

viagens.descricao: Trips of the lots scheduled with tracking: the driver on the map, live.

semRastreador.texto: Trips appear here, but the map and the driver link only work after registering the tracker in Administration › Integration.

viagens.erroRastreador: The tracker did not respond in the last check
viagens.finalizadasVazio: No finished trips in the period.

vazio.texto: When a lot is scheduled with "Track pickup = Yes", its trip appears here.

card.codigoAviso: (say it at the destination — never in the link)
card.copiaFalhou: Could not copy. Select and copy it manually.

alerta.titulo: Emergency on the trip of lot {{code}}: {{tipo}}

finalizar.texto: The driver reported arrival. Finishing ends tracking in their app and saves the route.
finalizar.avisoEmRota: The driver has NOT reported arrival yet. Finishing ends tracking in their app now and saves the route so far.

toast.falhou: Could not complete the action on the trip

mapa.poisZoom: Zoom in to see fuel and weigh stations.
mapa.poisIndisponivel: Fuel and weigh stations unavailable right now: the public OpenStreetMap service is busy. Try again in a few minutes.

painel.rastreadorIndisponivel: The tracker did not respond: the route may be incomplete.

replay.titulo: Replay of the trip of lot {{code}}
replay.mapa: Replay map of the trip of lot {{code}}
replay.inicio: Full route — play it to watch the truck move.

recebimento.encerra: Receiving the lot ends the trip in the driver app.
recebimento.semViagem: The driver has not started the trip yet; receiving the lot cancels the tracking.

estoque.lidoAs: Read from {{sistema}} at {{hora}} · view only (stock is managed there).
estoque.incompleto: Showing {{n}} of {{total}} items from {{sistema}} (the list is too large to bring in full).
estoque.semSerial: Temporary serial (the machine arrived without one)

descricoes.materiais: Warehouse pallets (Inventory-Management), read live — view only.
descricoes.assets: Computers from Notebook Control, read live — view only.
descricoes.pecas: Parts from Notebook Control, read live — view only.
descricoes.ecommerce: E-commerce stock by SKU and shelf (RTB WMS), read live — view only.

naoConfigurado.texto: Register the address and integration key of {{sistema}} in Administration › Integration for the list to appear here.

motivos.chave_recusada: {{sistema}} refused the integration key — check it in Administration › Integration
motivos.sem_resposta: {{sistema}} did not respond — try refreshing in a moment

estoque.incompletoSemTotal: Showing {{n}} items from {{sistema}} — the list is too large to bring in full.

historico.descricao: What changed in the stock of the three systems: iERP compares each read with the previous one (every 5 minutes and when stock is opened).
historico.erro: Could not load the stock history
